title: Delithiation effects on the structural, electronic, and electrical properties of LiSr0.8Fe0.1Ni0.1PO4 material
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,32131-32142
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02943K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
A. Mabrouki, Olfa Messaoudi, Lamia Trabelsi, Moufida Mansouri, Latifah Alfhaid
LiSr0.8Ni0.1Fe0.1PO4 material shows stable delithiation with a transition from semi-conducting to semi-metallic behavior. DFT and electrical studies reveal a 3.25–3.4 V window, highlighting its promise as a cathode material.
